items.claim: [r56-1] `tree-indent` hook records a fallback the Tree's CSS never takes
items.note: The hook now lists `calc(13px + var(--wzl-space-2))`, the indent a default Tree takes. `check:token-reads` no longer skips hooks marked `varies`: it fails one whose listed value no read falls back to. To see the real fallback, it follows the stylesheet's own custom properties and any private property the hook is handed on to.

items.claim: [r57-3] `useColorModePreference` keeps the old storage's choice when `storage` changes under the same key
items.note: It now reads the choice again from the new `storage`. A storage object made fresh on every render reads again each time but only stores a change, so it doesn't loop. A test covers that case.

items.claim: `--wzl-select-border` lists a value no read takes (`1px solid var(--wzl-border)`; a boxed trigger really draws `--wzl-field-border`'s fallback), sweep (found by the extended check)

`--wzl-button-confirm-bevel` lists `var(--wzl-bevel-raised)` and drops the `var(--btn-relief)` fallback its only read carries, and was marked `varies` without cause, sweep (found by the extended check)
themePrefsValues falls back missing selections like the schema, from A
Override hook set at only some selections shows another selection's value there, from B
items.note: It now reads as the hook's manifest fallback, which is what the page draws. The schema and themePrefsValues now share one lookup, `rowCssAt` in `prefs/tokens.ts`.

items.claim: A dimension token at a bare `0` gets a unitless number leaf, so an edit pins an invalid length, from B
items.note: A bare `0` now takes the unit of the token's other values, or px where they have none. `prefOfCss` reads a bare `0` on any number leaf that has a unit. The property test `prefs.pbt.test.ts` now treats `0` and `0px` as equal.

items.claim: `tree-indent` hook lists a fallback no Tree read carries
`themePrefsValues` reads a leaf as `undefined` at a selection its token does not resolve at, where the schema fills it from the fallback
`useColorModePreference` keeps the old storage's choice when `storage` changes under the same key

Reviewer B's report was empty, so all three findings came from A. Two are fixed and committed. The third (hook fallbacks) is fixed only where a hook has one true fallback. Hooks whose fallback differs by read site, including the finding's lead example `tree-indent`, are left as an open
Second same-named theme inherits the first's tokens
items.note: The first definition's rule now carries `:where(:not([data-wzl-variant]))`, so it no longer matches the second definition's elements.

items.claim: `httpThemeApi.get('list')` returns the list body typed as a theme
items.note: `get` throws and `put` answers `invalid` for a name the store cannot hold, including `list`, without sending a request. The client and `scripts/theme-store.ts` now share one name rule, `isStorableThemeName`.

items.claim: Hook `value` disagrees with the fallback kit CSS reads : partly
items.note:
partly a question.
  - `prop-row-h` now lists `var(--wzl-field-h, var(--wzl-control-h))`.
  - Hooks whose reads fall back differently by site are marked with a new `varies` field. That covers `tree-indent`, `tree-leading-size`, `button-icon-size`, `params-label-tracking`, and nine more.
  - `check:token-reads` now fails any read of an unmarked hook whose fallback is not the hook's listed value.
  - Question, recorded as Open in `docs/unruled.md`: how the theme prefs schema should show a `varies` hook's unset value. Today it shows one of the site fallbacks, and pinning it changes the reads that fall back to another.

items.claim: Three more hooks listed a fallback no read uses
items.note: the same mistake as the finding above. They are `disclosure-fill` (`var(--wzl-accent)`), `disclosure-target` (`var(--wzl-control-h-sm)`), and `prefs-rail-width` (`176px`). `TOKEN_MANIFEST` was regenerated.
